title: Kinetics of RNA and RNA:DNA Hybrid Strand Displacement
summary: Toehold length, substrate-end placement, and mismatch position are shown to tune the kinetics of RNA:RNA and RNA:DNA hybrid strand displacement.
significance: It supplies experimentally grounded design guidance for tuning RNA:RNA strand-displacement kinetics through toehold length, substrate-end placement, and mismatch position.

image.alt: Strand-displacement kinetics for RNA and RNA:DNA hybrid systems across toehold length, substrate-end placement, and mismatch position.
